# A constructive success theorem for contrastive partition acquisition

Draft new work; not independently reviewed. This is a discovery guarantee for
a precise class, followed by independent reuse validation. It is not a
universal representation learner or a new spectral-clustering claim.

## 1. Unknown class and receiving interface

There are n named states and two ordinary iid forward row samplers A0,A1.
All chosen rows and observed destinations may be retained. No reverse sampler,
common random seeds, true probabilities, partition, prototypes, rank, spectral
basis, or efficient teacher is supplied. The algorithm chooses a rational
resolution beta>0 and a confidence budget. All resolution/search attempts use
nonanticipating fresh samples and separately budgeted failure events.

For the SUCCESS theorem only, assume an unknown balanced partition P=ZW,
W=Z^T/k, r blocks, k=n/r, 2<=r<=n. Let J=I-11^T/n. Suppose

 C*=Z D W, D1=0, 1^T D=0, rank(D)=r-1,
 sigma_min_nonzero(D)=Delta >=256 sqrt(r) beta,
 ||(A1-A0)-C*||_2 <= beta/2.                         (1)

Also assume max_i ||[(A1-A0)-C*][i,:]||_1<=beta/32. These are properties
of the unknown family, not quantities the learner may simply assert. The final
independent reuse certificate is necessary even if discovery works.

An actual source family is A_a=K+Z C_a W+R_a with common arbitrary full-rank K,
centered macro C_a, and small R_a. K cancels from contrast expectations. For
future reuse, K must additionally reduce P (and suitable tasks must respect P),
or the later c/e/d certificate must otherwise pass. Contrast structure alone
does NOT imply a useful abstraction. Example failures will be kept explicit.

## 2. Acquiring operator accuracy without n^2 entrywise precision

A paid preliminary ordinary uniform-source sample acquires a simultaneous
column cap B>=max_(a,j)sum_i A_a(i,j), with B>=1. This is the inherited elementary
column-count certificate; no B=O(1) assertion is made for arbitrary sources.
Explicitly, for N_c uniform-source outcomes per action, a column count X_j has

# Prior matches and what this construction does not claim

This is an unreviewed discovery-to-validation join, not a new clustering method.

- Abid et al., *Contrastive Principal Component Analysis*, Section2, explicitly
  subtract weighted background covariance and use spectral directions to expose
  target structure. Background cancellation and contrastive spectral learning
  are therefore established. Our input is a pair of row-stochastic transition
  experiments rather than two covariance datasets; that distinction alone does
  not establish novelty. [Primary paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1709.06716)
- Lei--Zhu (2017), *Generic Sample Splitting for Refined Community Recovery in
  Degree Corrected Stochastic Block Models*, Section3/Algorithm1, turn an
  approximate clustering into exact recovery by fresh community-wise row
  statistics. This directly matches the cleanup principle. Their graph model
  has independent Bernoulli edges; our action-difference/multinomial-row model
  uses different noise accounting, not a new conceptual cleanup operation.
  [Primary paper](https://www3.stat.sinica.edu.tw/sstest/oldpdf/A27n413.pdf)
- Ordinary signed-graph spectral methods, SVD/randomized range methods and
  multi-view clustering get both full source datasets and all retained metadata.
  The dense exact sign filter is a constructive finite-bit backend, NOT a
  favorable timing baseline. A stable conventional SVD should be expected to
  outperform it computationally.

The particular success theorem now under construction joins: an arbitrary
common full-rank transition background; unknown balanced partition/rank; sampled
operator contrast with an ACQUIRED column cap; exact dyadic spectral filtering;
no-oracle coarse clustering; fresh named-row contrast cleanup; and a separate
uniform future-task reuse certificate. No supplied partition/prototypes/
reverse sampler/coupled seeds/optimal planner appear. The underlying separated
contrast class is a theorem hypothesis, not an empirically certified fact or
an assumption that every source satisfies it. Sampling/validation can refuse.

including tags from preliminary column-cap observations. The particular

# Contrastive discovery boundary — source/proof review candidate

This package banks a CLASS-SPECIFIC discovery theorem and an exact informative
failure. It does not establish a new consequential capability beyond strong
ordinary contrastive/community learners, and no historical novelty is claimed.

`PROOF.md` is the complete current draft. `QUESTION_AND_FIRST_CONSTRUCTION.md`
records the initial foothold; its preliminary status statements are not the
current implementation scope. `PRIOR_AND_SCOPE.md` records direct primary
matches (cPCA, Lei--Zhu cleanup, matrix Bernstein, ordinary polar/sign methods).
No true partition, rank, prototypes, useful basis, paired random seeds, reverse
sampler, k-means optimizer or planner is passed to the discovery functions.

The theorem learns a balanced hidden partition from noisy action contrasts
which cancel a common full-rank background. It explicitly acquires the column
cap, infers finite-resolution rank, prices precision and sample splitting, and
uses fresh row/block contrasts to clean up labels. The algorithm can refuse.
Recovering action-effect classes is NOT itself a reusable process model:
exact recovery can coexist with two-step value error 81/200=.405 when the common
background does not reduce that partition. Independent task/reuse validation
remains necessary and is not executed for this new class by this prototype.

    python -c 'import check_construct as c; print(c.run())'

dyadic filter precision, corrupted-label cleanup, the .405 counterexample,

test control flow; it is explicitly NOT empirical data or acquired evidence.
Zero new source observations were executed. No earlier historical tags/data

full discovery+reuse-validation pipeline is claimed.
